name: bisect
description: Find the module that breaks Hideout: from safe mode the hub halves the enabled set until one module is left; the saved enabled set is never edited.

steps.event: enabled set = [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h] (placeholder ids); hub is in safe mode
user chooses Find the module that breaks Hideout
round 1: turn off [e,f,g,h] for the session; user answers 'Still broken?': no
round 2: culprit in [e,f,g,h]; turn on [e,f], off [g,h]; user answers: yes
round 3: [e] on, [f] off; user answers: no
